name: markup: open a part and start the markup mode — an overlay over the view, the pen chosen, no markups yet

name: markup: a pen stroke makes the first markup on the current view; the stroke is simplified; undo and redo
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const ov = () => m.markup.overlay(); const P = (x, y) => { const r = ov().getBoundingClientRect(); return { clientX: r.left + x * r.width, clientY: r.top + y * r.height }; }; const fire = (type, x, y, o = {}) => ov().dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 7, button: 0, buttons: type === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1, ...P(x, y), ...o })); const stroke = async (pts, o) => { fire('pointerdown', ...pts[0], o); for (const p of pts.slice(1)) fire('pointermove', ...p, o); fire('pointerup', ...pts.at(-1), o); await sleep(120); }; const tool = async (k) => { q(`[data-pm="mk.tool:${k}"]`).click(); await sleep(80); }; const mk = () => m.markup.selected(); const R = (c) => JSON.stringify([c.target, c.dir, c.up, c.distance].flat().map((v) => Math.round(v * 1e6))); const cam = JSON.stringify(m.viewport.cameraState()); await stroke(Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => [0.2 + i * 0.01, 0.3 + 0.05 * Math.sin(i / 3)])); const a = mk(); const pen = a?.items[0]; const drawn = ov().querySelectorAll('polyline').length; const one = { markups: m.markup.list().length, kind: pen?.kind, simplified: pen?.pts.length < 30 && pen?.pts.length >= 3, camera: R(a?.camera) === R(JSON.parse(cam)), drawn, author: Boolean(a?.author) }; await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(150); const afterUndo = mk()?.items.length ?? 0; await m.actions.redo(); await sleep(150); return JSON.stringify({ ...one, afterUndo, redo: mk()?.items.length, redrawn: ov().querySelectorAll('polyline').length }); })()
